title: Length Conversion
text: Convert from length units to desired length units, 1 input, 1 output, {Initial unit} sets Input units; {Final unit} sets the input units. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Initial unit
params.values: Input units ft (default) | m | km | in | mi | naut mi

params.name: Final unit
params.values: Input units m (default) | ft | km | in | mi | naut mi
